idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; a node is a heap record on its parent's worker, the root's child i on worker i % cores; a report hands the parent the child's record, read and freed there; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. A node is one `new` and one `delete`, with no mailbox, no registry and no lifecycle beyond its record: the floor for growing and ending the tree

a node lives on its parent's worker and the root's child i on worker i % cores -- the same static placement qb has, so with cores=2 this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools, and nothing balances the root's subtrees
cores=1 is one thread with every node's messages in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
